target_claim: The inversion theorem recovers G from F without requiring the essential hypothesis α(1)≠0.
source_quote:
\begin{theorem}[Inversion Formula]\label{PreobInversionF} Let
\[
F(X)=\sum_{n\le X}\alpha(n)G\left(\frac Xn\right).
\]
Then we have
\[
G(X)=\sum_{n\le X}\beta(n)F\left(\frac Xn\right),
\]
where
